character: weary female agama, sandy-orange hide, backwards cap, mouth used for speech only, thick tail, fills two thirds of the frame height
props: three fat toads with string bags - their only place is her tail and her body, never the ground; a board with the number 399 in the ground beside the trail all clip, only digits on it; loose vegetables
motion_rule: the toads touch her every window, never at a distance; she fights back every window - wrenching, kicking, elbowing, shaking them off - never merely walks; she drives her body at the lens; new shot size every window
environment: dusty clay trail running to the lens, hard midday sun, hard shadows; background under a third

audio.delivery: weary female voice, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: stress: sbra-SY-va-yu, KHVOST, tya-zhe-LO, sbra-SY-va-ye-te, TSE-ny, ras-TUT
audio.pacing: brisk pacing, no drawling, every line fits its window
audio.lip_sync: mouth moves on every syllable, never a voice-over
audio.sfx: clay scraping, toad croaks, a dry pop as the tail tears

timeline.a: drives out of the depth at the lens | three toads clustered on her tail, bags ploughing dust
drives her shoulder back into a toad climbing her spine | it slides off, grip never loosening
two rolling strides, she boots the middle toad with a hind foot | its bag snags a stone, jerking her hip
leans into the pull, claws cutting two furrows | all three anchor back, one climbs her spine, shrugged off
throws her head into the lens, elbows the toad off her spine | it tears free, swinging, still on the tail
wrenches her hips, tears the cluster out of the rut, lunges on | all three swing out like a pendulum
drags the cluster right past the 399 board | the outer toad's bag slams it, the board shudders, she is shoved
one heave on both front claws and the tail rips off at the base | all three ride away on the severed tail
freed, she flies two body lengths into the lens and lands on her belly, skidding
claws into the clay, swings her body round | behind her the severed tail lashes, tossing the toads
crawls on her elbows at the lens | the tail flings all three up, vegetables rain, a tomato hits her
kicks a toad off her hip and hauls herself forward | two flop into the dust, one lands on her foot
throws herself after the departing tail and misses, raking dust | the third rides it past the 399 board
a new tail shoots from the stump and jolts her back, she turns her head into the lens | a toad grips it

must_appear: toads on her tail and the 399 board from 0.0; a bag strikes the board at 5.2; the tail rips off at 6.15-6.9; the severed tail in frame after 6.9; a new tail at 9.6
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, subtitles, captions, watermark, cyrillic, any letters on the 399 board, static camera, same shot size twice, only her head moving, a gap between her and the toads, a window where the toads do nothing, her merely walking, the severed tail gone from frame, her still while only the tail moves, anything held in her mouth, extra limbs, deformed anatomy, character changing mid-shot, English speech, Latin letters, any word after 6.9, blood, props hovering in mid-air
